cases.title: A signed-in DMG user sees ElevenLabs and Fish voices without provider keys
cases.userStory: As a Tristr Flow customer, I can choose either provider after signing in.
setupInstrumentation: No local ElevenLabs or Fish keys
Backend request log with secrets redacted
steps: Open onboarding voice choice and Preferences
Search for Fish and ElevenLabs voices
expectedResults: Curated ElevenLabs and backend Fish voices appear
No provider key appears in desktop storage, requests, or responses

cases.title: Fish reading streams through Render and consumes Tristr credits once
cases.userStory: As a signed-in user, I can hear a Fish voice with synchronized highlighting using my Tristr credits.
steps: Read known text with a Fish voice
expectedResults: Only /api/tts is called by the DMG
proofToCapture: Before/after credit values and usage fields

cases.title: Account-backed Fish and ElevenLabs previews use the service
cases.userStory: As a signed-in user, I can preview either provider before choosing a voice.
expectedResults: Provider errors remain visible and do not hang the UI

cases.title: Local provider keys remain an explicit direct-mode override
cases.userStory: As an advanced user, I can use my own Fish or ElevenLabs account without spending Tristr credits.
expectedResults: Tristr credits do not change in direct mode

cases.title: Fish endpoints fail closed and never expose the service key
cases.userStory: As the operator, I can safely fund Fish centrally without shipping the credential.
steps: Call voice and TTS endpoints anonymously
expectedResults: FISH_API_KEY never appears in payloads or the DMG
